blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in South Meadows fell from 14 in June to 11 in October (−21.4%), and 14 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 37.9% of Pitt Meadows’s 29 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in South Meadows?

items.t: The unit counts step up by zone: R-3 allows up to 3 units per lot, R-4 up to 4 units, and R-6 up to five units, or six where at least one unit meets the adaptable housing requirements in the BC Building Code on lots close to frequent transit.

The townhouse zones sit beside the house zones in the same bylaw: RM-1 Multi-Family Residential 1 (townhouse) carries a minimum lot area of 0.4 hectares, and RM-2 (townhouse and low-density apartment) a minimum lot area of 3,035 square metres.

blocks.text: South Meadows Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Bonson Park, at 11546 Bonson Road, holds a disc golf course; Pitt Meadows Athletic Park is at 11431 Bonson Road; the arena complex has three sheets of ice; and the community garden is at 11410 Bonson Road.
Shoreline Park, at 51 Bonson Road, sits on the Fraser River, the Fraser River shoreline park on Barnston View Road is also known as xcəwás, and dyke-top trails run along the Fraser River.

The South Bonson Community Centre and the Pitt Meadows Art Gallery are both at 10932 Barnston View Road in Osprey Village, and the city's only library branch, Pitt Meadows Public Library, is at 200-12099 Harris Road in Central Meadows.

items.t: Pitt Meadows City Hall is at 12007 Harris Road, and property tax payment options are published on the City's property taxes payment page.
The speculation and vacancy tax applies in Pitt Meadows, so owners declare annually.

items.t: Check the ditch and watercourse setback before planning: residential buildings in these zones are sited at least 15.0 metres from watercourses and key or constructed ditches, and much of the pocket is low dyke-protected ground by the Fraser River.
Confirm the zone on the specific lot — RS, R-3, R-4 or R-6 — because the unit count and the subdivision minimum turn on it.
Confirm the SD42 catchment for the exact address in the district locator, since no public school building stands inside the sub-area.

blocks.text: Jared's take on South Meadows
Osprey Village and the South Bonson Community Centre anchor South Meadows, the South Bonson stretch of the Bonson Road corridor that runs from Hammond Road and the rail tracks down to the Fraser.
South Meadows home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 houses sold in South Meadows with a median price of $1,320,000 (the middle half sold between $1,111,250 and $1,400,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $505 per square foot, a median year built of 1981 and a median lot of 5,896 square feet.
